text: {"claims":[{"cid":"c1","text":"A meta-analysis of 82 studies found a small but positive average effect of working from home on employee productivity.","cited_pids":["0a130e4f39dc#0"]},{"cid":"c2","text":"The positive WFH productivity effect was driven by gains in hourly productivity and more hours worked.","cited_pids":["0a130e4f39dc#0"]},{"cid":"c3","text":"A review of more than 50 studies reports a median productivity impact of +10% for focused individual tasks.","cited_pids":["d658dc380b73#5"]},{"cid":"c4","text":"A review of more than 50 studies reports a median productivity impact of -4% for collaborative tasks.","cited_pids":["d658dc380b73#5"]},{"cid":"c5","text":"Fully remote work has been linked to output reductions of 10-20% for some roles, especially collaboration-heavy ones or newly hired workers.","cited_pids":["d658dc380b73#6"]},{"cid":"c6","text":"In one randomized trial, hybrid schedules showed no measurable productivity difference from in-office peers.","cited_pids":["d658dc380b73#5"]},{"cid":"c7","text":"Conscientiousness is positively associated with reported productivity when working from home.","cited_pids":["44ecc13330bd#0"]},{"cid":"c8","text":"Full-remote work has been associated with reduced work productivity and worsening presenteeism.","cited_pids":["abefd158b9c2#2"]}]}
